newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy to hold off sale of assets.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy to hold off sale of assets.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp said Wednesday it has decided to defer consideration of the sale of its assets and will continue to pursue its normal course of business.

Chairman and Chief Executive Joseph Castle II said in a statement that before any sale takes place, the board believes it should resolve issues raised in a lawsuit over gas prices on its Rusk County, Texas, leases.
The company also said it expects to retire the current outstanding debt of $8.9 million, encumbering its Texas assets, before the end of January.
Castle Energy Corp. is not affiliated with Castle Oil Corp.
